about_pullquote: We answer the phone because we know burst pipes don't wait for office hours.
about_para_1: KK Plumbing and Heating has served Southend-on-Sea and the surrounding area for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that a plumbing emergency shouldn't mean a night of worry, we've built our reputation on fast, reliable response and honest pricing. We're Gas Safe Registered and carry the right parts on every callout.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we show up when we say we will, explain the problem clearly, and charge fairly. We're not interested in the hard sell — just fixing your problem and getting you back to normal. That's why over 80% of our work comes from repeat customers and personal recommendation.
reviews_heading: What Southend Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Pipe burst at 11pm on a Sunday — didn't think anyone would come out. KK were here by midnight and had it sorted within an hour. Proper job, fair price, and no hassle. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Been using KK for boiler servicing for three years now. Always professional, always on time, and they spot little issues before they become big problems. That's peace of mind worth paying for.
reviews.author: Patricia H.

reviews.text: New central heating system installed last month. They explained everything clearly, did a tidy job, and even cleaned up after themselves. Would definitely recommend to anyone on our street.
reviews.author: David W.
